title: For an 8-tonne pipe-fitting solution-treatment furnace, must the charging-machine load include the basket?
summary: Suneng's 2016 rapid solution-treatment furnace proposal for stainless-steel pipe fittings specifies a furnace load of 5–8 t per batch excluding fixture support blocks, while requiring a transfer fork truck with a maximum single-load capacity of at least 8 T under uniform loading, including fixtures. The figures are close but use different weight definitions. Count baskets and travelling fixtures in transfer weight; an 8 t furnace load does not prove that the truck can transfer 8 t of net workpieces.
